import sys

def apply(s, x, m, n):
    if s < m:
        return (s + x) % n
    else:
        return (s + n - x) % n

def apply_all(s, m, n):
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        if s < m:
            s = (s + i) % n
        else:
            s = (s + n - i) % n
    return s

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    m = int(next(it))
    s = int(next(it)) - 1
    t = int(next(it))

    while t % n != 0:
        x = t % n
        s = apply(s, x, m, n)
        t -= 1

    cant = t // n
    next_map = {}

    while cant > 0 and s not in next_map:
        before = s
        s = apply_all(s, m, n)
        next_map[before] = s
        cant -= 1

    if cant > 0:
        cycle = 1
        p = next_map[s]
        while p != s:
            p = next_map[p]
            cycle += 1
        rem = cant % cycle
        while rem > 0:
            s = next_map[s]
            rem -= 1

    print(s + 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
